newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil to begin laying NorFra gas line.
newsitem.headline: Statoil to begin laying NorFra gas line.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it would begin this week installation of the 840-km NorFra gas trunkline, the world's longest submarine pipeline.
Two laybarges, DLB 1601 and LB200, will begin laying 825 km of the line between the North Sea Draupner E riser platform and Dunkerque in northern France.

Statoil's Status Weekly newsletter said the DLB 1601 will lay the 546-km section running southwards from the Dutch continental shelf towards the French port, and expected to advance at more than two kilometres per day.
The other vessel will lay the NorFra section running southwards from Draupner E.

Total investment in the NorFra pipeline and landfall is put at roughly 8.5 billion crowns ($1.2 billion). Pipelaying is scheduled to be completed in November with gas deliveries starting on October 1, 1998.
